note: State measured: commit be86ab2e1 of the branch fix/3801-measure-journey, on the base of epic/EP-10 at 3d7249007 (US-2420, #3855 merged: the indicators, the workload and the projection of expenses are in the journey). The measure took the station in exclusive mode and waited for the heavy runs to end, but light work of other deliverers went on beside it (at the start of the second command: Next, the Keycloak configuration, a back test run of another worktree), the load average was 14.7 before the first command, 10.2 before the second and 10.3 at its end, so the figures carry some contention. PRJ-001 of the loaded witness (1000 tasks, 4999 lines of estimate), under fifty virtual users (k6), five passes and three passes of the heavy paths. It replaces the report of 2026-11-16 (EP-26, commit bae29e7de of lot/US-2300/L3), whose medians are quoted in each operation. The window of the browser went from 1280x720 to 1366x768 (#3801), which changes the layout the screens are measured in: with the heavier load, one reason why the figures of the two reports are not strictly comparable. The load: 1015 gestures of the 1122 expected (90 %), in 224 s, against 652 in 144 s on 2026-11-16: 915 reads and 100 writes, 2036 requests; reads_refused 0, unauthorised 0, one write refused (the label, status 0, a lone refusal tolerated by max(floor(1 % of n), 1) and named in conditions.load.refusals); 6 reads and 11 writes refused by the marking (409 STATE_FORBIDS_OPERATION), counted apart as reads_frozen and writes_frozen). Served now: the indicators, and the workload with the projection of expenses (US-2420). Exceeding the objective: recompute-after-entry (2.482 s for 1 s, EP-26: 1.999 s) and indicators (4.91 s for 1 s; the cache, one scope read cold, 1.256 s). Degraded by more than 25 % against 2026-11-16: workload-or-projection (0.574 s to 0.805 s, +40 %, the projection being added) and mark-revision (0.101 s to 6.442 s, still under its 60 s). Not corrected here (#3802, #3569). Still not served, with their epic: the portfolio (EP-11), the compared grid and the entry in a compared grid (EP-27). Gaps already decided, outside the table: createRevision on PRJ-001 is 2.35 s for the 2 s asked (decision of 2026-11-15, #3314 option B, US-2240), not an operation of table 15; the duration that redates 957 tasks, about 0.8 s, gain under the dispersion (decisions of 2026-11-16, US-2250), is read in recompute-after-entry. The three hundred projects and fifteen years of revisions of the reference set (WF-QUA-0040) are for EP-13, which replays this measure on it. The volume of the guarded reads (US-2270) is NOT measured by this report: it is a calculation validated by the author, not a measure. 76 bytes per node x 5994 nodes (PRJ-001) x 600 projects x 180 revisions = about 49 GB, that is 25 to 33 % of the 150 to 200 GB of 4.6.2 (the 82 GB put forward earlier is not retained). Hypotheses: 5994 nodes per revision, that of PRJ-001, for every project; 180 revisions guarded per project, every marked revision read at least once (a revision never read is not guarded); 76 bytes per node as stored, without the compression of PostgreSQL, which would lower it.
